detail.longDescription: My local grocery store decided to be insufferable a few weeks ago and rearrange the aisles. I used to be able to walk through that place blindfolded if I wanted to. Now, it takes me 10 minutes to find the right beans because, for some reason, the dried and canned varieties are multiple aisles away (who does that?). HubSpot AI tools are also remodeling.
